result.title: 3AGameFactory-Motion: Agentic Rigging and Reliable Complex Motion Generation for Diverse 3D Assets
result.summary: Animating arbitrary 3D assets from instructions requires both structural inference and motion control, yet existing motion benchmarks mostly cover conventional human or animal skeletons with simple instructions. We introduce DivDynBench, which evaluates rigging and motion generation across six morphology categories, with instructions requiring multi-phase part coordination and explicit timing, angle, repetition, and trajectory constraints. With large language models, we systematically compare three common paradigms: specialized motion generation, video generation followed by motion recovery, and direct agent-driven generation. We analyze their control capabilities, cross-morphology adaptability, and generation costs. Guided by this comparison, we propose an Agentic Motion Framework in which an agent writes compact parametric skeleton and motion programs, and a deterministic executor performs rigging, kinematic solving, and geometric correction. Compact parameter control reduces generation overhead and improves rigging reliability and motion-control accuracy, providing practical guidance for deploying complex 3D motion generation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 DivDynBench，用于评测多类形态 3D 资产的骨骼绑定与多阶段复杂运动生成，并比较专用运动生成、视频生成后恢复运动、agent 直接生成三种范式，进而提出由 agent 编写参数化骨架与运动程序、确定性执行器完成绑定与运动学求解的框架。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作聚焦 3D 绑定与运动合成的工程流程和基准，不涉及 VLM 内部视觉表示、latent 推理状态生成或证据获取与停止决策，agent 与确定性执行器的分工也未构成可供核查的状态或贡献分配线索。
